_doc: STAGING. General pack. The clue gate is binding: every clue names a position, a time, or a habit — never a category. "The gas station you stop at not because you need gas" passes; "a long drive with your family" fails and is re-authored. Bases are drawn only from letter-sets no cultural pack holds, so a general theme never takes a board from the material the product is built on.

theme.name: The Road Trip
theme.blurb: Eleven hours, one playlist, and a gas station nobody needed.

boards.scene: Hour two, before anyone is tired of anyone

clues.roadie: Whoever loaded the trunk, and they are not to be questioned about the order
clues.radio: Scanned until the third station, which is the one everybody agrees on
clues.read: The exit numbers out loud, by the one person who does not need to
clues.ride: Shotgun, claimed at the door of the house before anybody was outside
clues.road: Still four lanes at this point, which will not be true by dark
clues.aide: What the person with the phone becomes about forty minutes in

clues.rained: Started somewhere around the state line and has not let up since
clues.diner: Chosen off a sign, not a review, and the pie is the correct order
clues.read: The laminated menu twice, front and back, while nobody decides
clues.ride: Half an hour shorter if this stop had not happened, and worth it
clues.dine: What you came in claiming you would not do, sixty seconds ago
clues.rein: Handed over at the counter: whoever is driving next gets the coffee

boards.scene: The swap, in a lot with the engine running

clues.driven: Four hours by the same person, and the argument about it is starting
clues.drive: Handed over reluctantly, with commentary, at a gas pump at dusk
clues.diner: Two exits back, and the person who wanted it is still saying so
clues.ride: Different from the passenger seat, and everyone forgets that
clues.vein: On the back of the hand at ten and two, hour five
clues.dive: Into the cooler in the footwell, blind, for whatever is left

boards.scene: What is in the back, and what is on top of it

clues.trunks: Two of them, and the second one is why nothing can be reached
clues.trunk: Packed at eleven last night by somebody who had a system
clues.turn: Missed at the exact moment the bag on top slides forward
clues.sun: Straight through the back window from about four, and no shade in it
clues.runt: The smallest bag, containing the only things anybody needs
clues.stun: What the heat off the tarmac does when the hatch finally opens

boards.scene: Hour seven, and the temperature question

clues.argues: About the vent, every trip, and it has been the same three sentences since 2009
clues.argue: What the back seat does about the window, at a volume the front can hear
clues.gas: Three quarters full, and the person driving wants to stop anyway
clues.sugar: In the coffee at the last stop, six of them, and it is being mentioned
clues.urges: The one at hour seven that has nothing to do with the bladder
clues.sage: What nobody in this car is being, and they know it

boards.scene: The last hour, in the dark

clues.piston: The noise it started making outside Chattanooga, still unexplained
clues.stop: Refused now, on principle, with under an hour to go
clues.point: At the sign, silently, because everybody is past talking
clues.spin: Of the tire in gravel at the last turn, and nobody comments
clues.pints: What is waiting, and it is the only thing keeping the car quiet
clues.snip: Of the bag corner, for the last of the crisps, at eleven at night

boards.scene: The playlist, and who is in charge of it

clues.loaned: The aux, once, briefly, and never again after that
clues.lane: Changed for no reason during the chorus, and everybody noticed
clues.load: Queued at the house so nothing has to be chosen at seventy
clues.alone: How the person in the third row feels about the song selection
clues.dean: The name of the road the sat-nav keeps saying, and it is not a road
clues.lend: What nobody does with the charger, at any point in eleven hours

boards.scene: The nap, and who is allowed one

clues.alpine: The air setting nobody chose, blowing at the one person asleep
clues.nap: Taken by whoever drove first, immediately, and it looks like betrayal
clues.lane: Drifted toward twice before the passenger says anything about it
clues.pain: In the neck of the person who slept against the window
clues.pale: What the driver goes when the fuel light finally comes on
clues.plane: What somebody points out would have taken ninety minutes

clues.genius: What the person who packed the snacks is called, at hour six
clues.sign: Read aloud in a voice, for the fourth time, and it is still funny
clues.sing: Only the chorus, only in the tunnel, and only all together
clues.sun: Down finally, which is when the car gets quiet and stays quiet
clues.guns: On the billboard, and there is a conversation about it and then there is not
clues.using: The good speaker in the back, discovered at hour nine

clues.parent: Says five more minutes at the stop and means twenty, every time
clues.nap: Announced as a plan and then defended for the next two hours
clues.tape: In the glovebox, from a car that has not existed since 2004
clues.rent: The car, and the conversation about the insurance at the counter
clues.pane: The window somebody keeps touching, and the mark is permanent now
clues.trap: The middle seat, given to whoever got in last, without discussion

boards.scene: The last fill-up before the interstate

clues.laughs: At the pump price, out loud, and then pays it anyway
clues.gas: Cheaper one exit further and everybody finds that out afterwards
clues.haul: What is still ahead, said in a tone, by the person not driving
clues.slug: Of the drink left in the cup from three hours ago, taken anyway
clues.gals: In the car behind, doing exactly the same trip, going the other way
clues.hags: What the group photo at the pump makes everybody claim they look like

boards._note: Letter-set on loan from cookout, which has 133 boards of measured headroom and keeps 132 after this. The older rule said a finished pack always outranks one in progress; that was written before the headroom was measured and is too strict where the donor cannot possibly run out.
boards.scene: The rest stop at the state line

clues.hearts: What the sign at the welcome center claims the state is full of
clues.rest: Taken for eleven minutes, of which nine are spent finding the door
clues.seat: Warm from four hours and somehow still claimed when you get back
clues.share: The last of the crisps, unwillingly, at a picnic table nobody wiped
clues.heat: Off the tarmac through the soles of your shoes, at three in the afternoon
clues.hear: The interstate from the picnic table, and it never actually stops
